newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR softer on declining interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR softer on declining interest rates.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly weaker, except for the two-month and three-month maturities which remained unchanged at 11.3125 and 11.4375 percent respectively, traders said on Thursday.
"Declining domestic interest rates had prompted many banks to lower their swap rates," a trader said.
Philippine interbank call loan rates were steady, with the average stuck at 11.0625 percent.
The Central Bank maintained its overnight borrowing rate at 11 percent and its lending rate at 13 percent.
